quests.instruction: Look carefully. Which animal here is a bird?
quests.question: Bird
quests.hint: This animal has a fan of large tail feathers.
quests.explanation: Yes! The turkey is a bird. It lives on a farm.
quests.funFact: A baby turkey is called a poult!

quests.instruction: One of these animals only eats plants. Which one?
quests.question: Plant Eater
quests.hint: This animal lives fluttering over garden flowers.
quests.explanation: Correct! The butterfly only eats plants. It has two pairs of colorful, patterned wings.
quests.funFact: Some butterflies fly thousands of miles to a warmer home!

quests.instruction: Look carefully. Which animal here is a mammal?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has short horns and a little beard.
quests.explanation: Yes! The goat is a mammal. It lives on a rocky farm hillside.
quests.funFact: A baby goat is called a kid!

quests.instruction: One of these animals is a fish. Which one?
quests.question: Fish
quests.hint: This animal has shiny orange scales and gentle fins.
quests.explanation: Yes! The goldfish is a fish. It lives swimming in a bowl or a pond.
quests.funFact: Some goldfish can live for more than 20 years!

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that is a mammal?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has a long flowing mane and strong legs.
quests.explanation: Yes! The horse is a mammal. It lives on a big open farm.
quests.funFact: Horses can sleep both lying down and standing up!

quests.instruction: Look at the choices. Which animal eats both plants and meat?
quests.question: Eats Everything
quests.hint: This animal lives paddling in a calm pond.
quests.explanation: Correct! The turtle eats both plants and meat. It has a hard round shell on the back.
quests.funFact: A turtle's shell is actually part of its skeleton!

quests.instruction: Which animal makes its home in a pond?
quests.question: In a pond
quests.hint: Look for the animal with a hard round shell on the back.
quests.explanation: Great job! The turtle lives in a pond. You can spot it by a hard round shell on the back.
quests.funFact: A turtle's shell is actually part of its skeleton!

quests.instruction: Which animal says "Baa"?
quests.question: Baa
quests.hint: Think of an animal that lives on a green farm.
quests.explanation: Yes! A sheep says "Baa". It also has a fluffy woolly coat.
quests.funFact: A sheep's woolly coat can be made into warm sweaters!

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that lives in the jungle?
quests.question: In the jungle
quests.hint: Look for the animal with a long body with no legs at all.
quests.explanation: Great job! The snake lives in the jungle. You can spot it by a long body with no legs at all.
quests.funFact: A snake uses its tongue to smell the air around it!

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that is a reptile?
quests.question: Reptile
quests.hint: This animal has a long body with no legs at all.
quests.explanation: Yes! The snake is a reptile. It lives slithering through the grass.
quests.funFact: Some snakes can go for weeks without eating!

quests.instruction: Which animal has black and yellow stripes and tiny wings?
quests.question: Black and yellow stripes and tiny wings
quests.hint: This animal usually lives buzzing around flowers in a garden.
quests.explanation: That's right! The bee has black and yellow stripes and tiny wings. It says "Buzz".
quests.funFact: A bee visits many flowers to collect sweet nectar!

quests.instruction: A group of geese has a special name. What is it?
quests.question: Goose
quests.hint: Think about where geese usually live: on a farm pond.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of geese is called a flock. They like to stay together on a farm pond.
quests.funFact: Geese usually stay with the same partner for life!

quests.instruction: One of these animals is an amphibian. Which one?
quests.question: Amphibian
quests.hint: This animal has big round eyes and long jumping legs.
quests.explanation: Yes! The frog is an amphibian. It lives in a splashy pond.
quests.funFact: A baby frog is called a tadpole and it starts life swimming!

quests.instruction: A baby goose has a special name. What is it called?
quests.question: Goose
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like a long neck and orange webbed feet.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby goose is called a gosling. Grown-up geese live on a farm pond.
quests.funFact: Geese often fly together in a big letter V shape!

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that is a mammal?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has black and white stripes from head to tail.
quests.explanation: Yes! The zebra is a mammal. It lives on the grassy plains.
quests.funFact: No two zebras have exactly the same stripe pattern!

quests.instruction: Which animal is a mammal?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has black and white spots and a gentle moo.
quests.explanation: Yes! The cow is a mammal. It lives in a green farm pasture.
quests.funFact: Cows can make friends with other cows!

quests.instruction: Look carefully. Which animal here is a mammal?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has a long tail for swinging between trees.
quests.explanation: Yes! The monkey is a mammal. It lives high in the jungle trees.
quests.funFact: Monkeys love to eat fruit, especially bananas!

quests.instruction: What do we call a group of goldfish?
quests.question: Goldfish
quests.hint: Think about where goldfish usually live: swimming in a bowl or a pond.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of goldfish is called a school. They like to stay together swimming in a bowl or a pond.
quests.funFact: A goldfish breathes underwater using body parts called gills!

quests.instruction: A baby zebra has a special name. What is it called?
quests.question: Zebra
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like black and white stripes from head to tail.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby zebra is called a foal. Grown-up zebras live on the grassy plains.
quests.funFact: No two zebras have exactly the same stripe pattern!

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that lives in the ocean?
quests.question: In the ocean
quests.hint: Look for the animal with shiny orange scales and gentle fins.
quests.explanation: Great job! The goldfish lives in the ocean. You can spot it by shiny orange scales and gentle fins.
quests.funFact: A goldfish breathes underwater using body parts called gills!

quests.instruction: A group of bees has a special name. What is it?
quests.question: Bee
quests.hint: Think about where bees usually live: buzzing around flowers in a garden.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of bees is called a swarm. They like to stay together buzzing around flowers in a garden.
quests.funFact: Bees dance to tell other bees where to find flowers!

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that is a mammal?
quests.question: Mammal
quests.hint: This animal has a big furry mane around the face.
quests.explanation: Yes! The lion is a mammal. It lives prowling the wild savanna grasslands.
quests.funFact: A lion's roar can be heard from up to 5 miles away!

quests.instruction: A baby bear has a special name. What is it called?
quests.question: Bear
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like thick fur and sharp claws.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby bear is called a cub. Grown-up bears live in a den in the forest.
quests.funFact: Baby bear cubs stay close to their mother to learn and grow!

quests.instruction: Which animal is an insect?
quests.question: Insect
quests.hint: This animal has black and yellow stripes and tiny wings.
quests.explanation: Yes! The bee is an insect. It lives buzzing around flowers in a garden.
quests.funFact: Bees dance to tell other bees where to find flowers!

quests.instruction: Which animal is a bird?
quests.question: Bird
quests.hint: This animal has bright, colorful tail feathers.
quests.explanation: Yes! The rooster is a bird. It lives in a farmyard at sunrise.
quests.funFact: A rooster's colorful feathers help it stand out!

quests.instruction: A group of zebras has a special name. What is it?
quests.question: Zebra
quests.hint: Think about where zebras usually live: on the grassy plains.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of zebras is called a herd. They like to stay together on the grassy plains.
quests.funFact: A zebra's stripes may help confuse animals that hunt it!

quests.instruction: Which animal lives together in a "school"?
quests.question: School
quests.hint: This animal has shiny orange scales and gentle fins.
quests.explanation: That's right! A group of goldfish is called a school. You can find them swimming in a bowl or a pond.
quests.funFact: A goldfish breathes underwater using body parts called gills!

quests.instruction: Who is able to slither along the ground? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Slither along the ground
quests.hint: This animal lives slithering through the grass.
quests.explanation: Yes! The snake can slither along the ground. It has a long body with no legs at all.
quests.funFact: Some snakes can go for weeks without eating!

quests.instruction: One of these animals is a bird. Which one?
quests.question: Bird
quests.hint: This animal has a long neck and orange webbed feet.
quests.explanation: Yes! The goose is a bird. It lives on a farm pond.
quests.funFact: Geese usually stay with the same partner for life!

quests.instruction: Who is able to climb and jump on rocks? Choose the right animal!
quests.question: Climb and jump on rocks
quests.hint: This animal lives on a rocky farm hillside.
quests.explanation: Yes! The goat can climb and jump on rocks. It has short horns and a little beard.
quests.funFact: Goats have rectangle-shaped pupils in their eyes!
